title: Flask — Draft final assessment blueprint
purpose: Repository-side blueprint for future review and exam delivery integration. This does not claim a course-specific timed exam, automatic grading workflow or certificate issue path is currently enabled.

outcome_distribution.outcome: Understand Flask fundamentals, routing, request/response handling and templates
Build modular websites with configuration, sessions, data access and accounts
Design API/file integration contracts and verify behavior with tests
Address security, performance, production deployment, monitoring and extensibility

remediation: Review the lesson linked to each missed objective and complete its associated practice assignment before retrying.
grading: Draft blueprint only; a future implementation must grade on the server and protect answer keys. The current importer imports relational course content but does not persist this exam blueprint as a live timed assessment.
status_note: Proposed pass score and attempt count require product and assessment review. Certificate issuance remains unimplemented until a backend-verified passing result is supported.
